title: 汽车面板机场港口：智平方用多场景，喂机器人？
speaker: Guo Yendong

segments.en: What do you think commercialization really hasn't taken off yet?
segments.zh: 您认为商业化为何尚未真正起飞？

segments.en: And how many of these alpha bots, not the brain, the alpha bots, the actual humanoid robots with wheels?
segments.zh: 这些Alpha机器人，不是大脑，而是带轮子的实际人形机器人，有多少台？

segments.en: How many are deployed and what are your deliveries like this year and next?
segments.zh: 部署了多少台？今年和明年的交付情况如何？

segments.en: I see this is a very good question, because this humanoid, our general purpose robots, is not designed for a very specialized task.
segments.zh: 这个问题很好，因为这种人形机器人，我们的通用机器人，并非为非常专业化的任务而设计。

segments.en: So we invent the hardware, we design the hardware, we train the foundation model, then we find a lot of applications for all these robots.
segments.zh: 所以我们发明硬件、设计硬件、训练基础模型，然后为所有这些机器人找到大量应用。

segments.en: As I just mentioned, we already find some very interesting applications, very useful applications, such as I just mentioned, and another thing I want to mention is that this is APEC.
segments.zh: 正如我刚才提到的，我们已经找到一些非常有趣、非常有用的应用，比如刚提到的，另外我想提的是这次APEC。

segments.en: We even find applications with PSA, port of Singapore authority to help the workers at the port.
segments.zh: 我们甚至与PSA新加坡港务局找到应用，帮助港口工人。

segments.en: So all these applications, first of all, is very crucial to run the business.
segments.zh: 所有这些应用，首先对开展业务至关重要。

segments.en: Second of all, all these different applications help robot company to track data.
segments.zh: 其次，所有这些不同应用帮助机器人公司追踪数据。

segments.en: So the diversity of the data help us to train the brain of the robot to make the robot smarter and smarter.
segments.zh: 因此数据的多样性帮助我们训练机器人的大脑，让机器人越来越智能。

segments.en: Well, speaking of which, how are you impacted by perhaps computing power shortages
segments.zh: 说到这个，算力短缺对你们有多大影响？
